fact: SIRATPay, run by SIRAT SA with the ministries of Living Environment and of Economy and Finance, lets Benin motorists pay road tolls and penalties remotely without cash, per Fraternité.
The Senegalese finance minister said PI-SPI, launched 30 September 2025, facilitates payments of taxes, duties and fees among other operations.

Benin's Directorate General of Taxes unveiled new online services on 23 May 2024 to streamline tax payments for small businesses and property owners in Cotonou, on the e-services.impots.bj portal first launched in 2017.
